rationale: Adds the development-only pulp-ui-frames-observe tool, its test, and checked-in DesignIR, scripted-UI and schedule fixtures. The observer materializes an existing DesignIR (or loads a scripted UI), drives it from host timestamps a schedule supplies, and records every frame; no importer, DesignIR schema, Chromium capture, rendering, or packaging behavior changes, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves. It supplies the Pulp-side observation for the Vellum parity harness frames lane under the 2026-10-04 temporary Pulp exception.
